frontend_smoke.evidence: Incremental in-app Browser offline smoke for the homepage technical-SEO image update at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844. The 1672x941 WebP loaded successfully, the rendered page kept one H1, the mobile navigation stayed hidden, no horizontal overflow appeared, and there were no console warnings/errors. Browser-read JSON-LD resolved both WebPage and Product image fields to the same production WebP; automated tests separately validate the image sitemap entry. The localhost log contained only local page/asset GETs with no API request. This metadata-only change does not alter the previously verified preview, checkout, or paid-page behaviors. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for a measurement-only Worker change that does not alter checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or any customer response. The protected-source change is confined to GET /api/admin/growth-metrics: count parsing now rejects missing or null RPC fields instead of converting them to zero, and non-object rows return HTTP 502. The golden fixture now locks Worker/adapter source, privacy, limitations, range, goal/streak, totals, days, and attribution; it exposed and fixed stale adapter limitation text by aligning it to the Worker's more conservative settlement, diagnostic-session, and later-refund caveats. Identifier-free fixtures cover non-object and missing fields in both RPC result sets. All 11 Worker measurement/privacy/auth tests and the complete 36-test Node suite pass. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than deployment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
